overview: Cortex is a local-first codebase onboarding tool. It ingests a repo into a search index under .kt_index, then runs Claude Agent SDK agents (chat, guided tour, walkthrough) that answer only from the code, using 9 read-only tools. A FastAPI server (api/server.py) and a Typer CLI (cli/main.py) are thin front doors over the cortex package, which is split into index/, agents/, graph/ and storage/.

stops.excerpt:
"""Hybrid retrieval: lexical TF-IDF + dense semantic, fused with RRF.

TF-IDF nails exact identifiers ("rate_limit", "TfidfVectorizer"); dense
embeddings bridge vocabulary gaps ("sign in" -> `login`). Reciprocal Rank

contributes 1/(K + rank) from every list it appears in, so chunks that both
retrievers agree on float to the top. Set ONBOARDING_VECTOR_BACKEND=hybrid.

Costs the dense ingest time (ONNX embedding on CPU), so it suits small/medium
repos; tfidf remains the fast default.
"""

stops.insight: HybridStore merges TF-IDF and dense (fastembed) results with rrf_merge (reciprocal rank fusion), for better semantic recall.
